text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello, Tamtam. I just spotted Rice
rushing down the hall.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she wanted to do her costume
fitting tonight. I already let the
dorm
leaders know she'll be out past curfew.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That aside though,
Creek. I tried followin'
your advice, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Man is this whole wait-'n-watch thing
rough. This'd all be so much
easier if I
could help 'em.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I know the feeling. The two of us
will have our work cut out for
us as real
moms someday.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to my kingdom of the night! I-I'm
a vampire, and...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: What are you doing, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah! Oh, um. Well, I wanted to...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I want to apologize in advance!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This might be unwarranted, and it might
be a hassle, but still! I
really... I reaaally—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really want to help you!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But you're not on the...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm not in the plans, and I always
make things worse when I'm
around... but I
can't bear to see you toiling away all
alone!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, though, I'm not Rice! With this
costume, I'm a super
powerful, reliable
vampire!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If you reject my help,
I'll drink your blood
and force you to be my friend! We're
doing this together,
whether you like it or not!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A costume...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Halloween is a day to dress up and dare to
be someone else. You can
borrow the
costume's power to say things you can't
say yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I've made far too many miscalculations
lately...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...If I put on a costume, could I be like
someone else too?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am not the Mihono Bourbon you know.
I'm a ghost.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In order to help clear my cached
regrets, I
must ask you some
questions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I was entrusted with a certain mission,
and would like to complete the
related tasks
perfectly. However, there is something I
do not understand...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Typically, when one accepts responsibility
for a task, they are
expected to handle
said task themself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But...
what should I do if I find flaws in the
party's initial task
distribution?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Is it too late to change them? Would
accepting aid mean admitting
failure?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Bourbon...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing wrong with getting help.
Working together will make
the party an
even bigger success.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But if someone offers me help, doesn't
that mean they've deemed me
unfit to
complete the task myself?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! Everyone knows how
capable you are!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The plans were made under the
assumption that I would do my own
work,
though. If others joined me, would it not
affect their schedules?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-not as much as it would hurt us to see you overwork yourself. I think—no, I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: No more buts, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You know, for a ghost... you're just like
me, trying to hide how scared
you are.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And so, I want you to hear me out. I want to be your friend. I want to help you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And most of all, I don't want to see you
stressed or worried... I want
you to be
happy!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Then... would you mind helping me finish
eating the broken
jack-o'-lanterns?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'd be glad to!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm a pretty big eater, you know!

And finally, the day of the Halloween
Party arrives.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah! What's that?! T-there's a hand, a
zombie hand!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... What a lovely photo! Of you...
and of your new ghoul
friend!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, looks like this year's party is a
roaring success.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
We've still got plenty of spooky tricks up
our sleeve! Right, Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Attention,
prop team. I will now press
the switch.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Okay! Ready whenever!

text_block_list.name: Fog Machine
text_block_list.text: BEEP! Pssshhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Aaaah!

text_block_list.name: Vacuum
text_block_list.text: Fssshhh...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
As demonstrated, we have plenty of
surprises planned to entertain
guests like
you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Everyone brainstormed them
together. Hehehe! I even helped
a little
too.

text_block_list.name: Student
text_block_list.text: Tremble...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh. That girl over there is all by
herself...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Chomp!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I just used my powers to turn you
into a vampire like me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
How about you go turn that girl too? Once
you're bitten... you can
turn anyone into
another vampire friend!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I bet there are a whole bunch of people
here who would love to be friends
with
you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, the changing rooms are this way.
Don't worry if you didn't
apply for a
costume—we brought all kinds of spares.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hm, looks like there's no one left in line
for guidance, so I'm gonna
zip out and suit
up.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey Bourbon! You got the party zone
lookin' real snappy! The whole dorm's
been real coordinated, thanks to how hard
you've been
workin'.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
About that—I have something to say. I
know I caused you plenty of
the trouble.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? Not this again.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Tamamo. I am deeply
grateful for all the assistance and
advice
you provided.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haha, ya know what? You're cuter when ya
smile. And sorry for bein' a
busybody.
Now, I've gotta hurry and get
Halloweened up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Happy Halloween, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I hope you all have a magical evening, and
that you get to spend it
"letting loose"
with friends.
